evidence.negative_controls: Each negative verifies an owner-issued legacy JWT and unchanged same-signer reencoding through both APIs before adding only the recognized token_kind. Both marked-token results are evaluated before assertion.

facts: AccessClaims derives Deserialize and has no token_kind field or deny_unknown_fields attribute.
The common private helper currently calls decode::<AccessClaims>.
Both JwtIssuer::verify_access_token and JwtVerifier::verify_access_token call the same private helper.
Pinned serde_derive treats unrecognized fields as IgnoredAny; thus token_kind is discarded before returned AccessClaims.
static_current_failure_analysis.inference: Correctly signed otherwise valid legacy-shaped payloads with recognized Account protocol markers are currently accepted; expected3 selected results are1PASS2FAIL. Actual RED is root runtime work, not claimed observed here.

guide_refinement.responsible_layer: Only the common private verify_access_token helper and a private deserialization envelope in jwt.rs; keep public AccessClaims unchanged.
guide_refinement.minimal_shape: Private #[derive(Deserialize)] envelope with #[serde(flatten)] claims: AccessClaims and #[serde(default)] token_kind: serde_json::Value. Decode this envelope with the unchanged configured ES256 Validation. After successful decode, reject only token_kind.as_str() matching account_v1 or account_csrf_v1 with existing fixed jsonwebtoken::errors::ErrorKind::InvalidToken mapped through AuthError. Then apply the unchanged existing org/scope/group/tenant validation to the typed AccessClaims and return it.
guide_refinement.compatibility: No deny_unknown_fields on public legacy claims; no changed required public fields; no whole-payload Value roundtrip; unrelated unknown marker values remain outside the policy of this lane. Missing marker defaults to JSON null and follows existing legacy behavior. The envelope must not be used to select a parser based on unverified fields.
guide_refinement.duplicate_field_reasoning: Pinned serde flatten collects a Vec of individual key/value pairs, then FlatStructAccess replays each recognized pair into the derived AccessClaims visitor. Its duplicate_field guard remains active; this avoids collapsing duplicate known fields through a JSON object map. Duplicate recognized token_kind keys are rejected by the envelope derive, preventing a last-value overwrite of a recognized marker.
guide_refinement.runtime_validation_after_admission: Same unchanged selected3 probe must become GREEN, plus existing jwt_es256 and complete jwt_verifier regression targets. Capture exact counts; generic invalid marker error must not echo the marker/token/claims.
guide_refinement.supplemental_coverage_gap: Current3 selected tests do not exercise raw duplicate known claims or duplicate recognized protocol markers, nor all configured cryptographic validation failures. Consider raw duplicate org/roles and recognized token_kind runtime controls in the supplemental crypto suite; static serde inspection is not runtime duplicate-field evidence.

pre_mortem: An invalid signer could make a negative pass; a fix in only one public API could leave the other permissive; a whole JSON Value conversion could silently accept duplicate known claims.
blast_radius: Private legacy JWT verification only; tests reuse one existing registered binary; no database/session/route/public contract or generated artifact changes.
detection: Same-signer controls and both API booleans in each negative; unchanged original issuance/assertions; later duplicate-field supplemental crypto controls.
rollback: Preserve exact candidate and root RED/GREEN evidence. Any demonstrated compatibility regression requires reviewed correction/revert of the isolated helper; no destructive shared-workspace operation.
